scenes.title: 🏭 工厂参观接待

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Welcome to our factory! Let me give you a quick safety briefing first. Please put on this helmet and vest.

dialogue.speaker: Client
dialogue.text: Sure. I have to say, the facility looks very impressive from the outside.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you! We've recently upgraded our production line. Let me walk you through the process — from raw material to finished product.

dialogue.speaker: Client
dialogue.text: How many units can you produce per day at full capacity?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Currently about 5,000 units per day. With the new equipment coming next month, we'll reach 8,000.

scenes.tips: 💡 关键短语：safety briefing（安全须知）、walk through（走一遍/参观）、full capacity（满产）

culture_tip.title: 跨文化小贴士：东南亚客户篇
points: 🙏 合十礼：泰国等国家用合十礼代替握手，双手合十于胸前
👣 脚部禁忌：不要把脚底朝向他人，也不要用脚指东西
🗣️ 保全面子：避免公开批评或让人难堪，用委婉方式提建议
🎁 小礼物：拜访时带点家乡特产或公司小礼品，很受欢迎
📱 社交沟通：WhatsApp/Line 比邮件更常用，回复速度也更快

listening.title: Handling a Customer Complaint
listening.text:
A: I'm calling about the shipment we received yesterday. About 10% of the items are damaged.
B: Oh, I'm really sorry to hear that. Can you send me some photos of the damaged items?
A: Sure, I'll email them right away. What's the next step?
B: Once I see the photos, I'll arrange a replacement shipment immediately. No extra charge, of course.
A: Thank you. I appreciate the quick response.
B: Not at all. We take quality issues very seriously. You'll have the replacements within a week.

looks.title: 一字肩针织上衣 + 直筒牛仔半裙

top.desc: 浅粉色一字肩针织衫，露锁骨不露手臂，袖口微喇修饰

bottom.desc: 浅蓝直筒牛仔半裙，中长款过膝，前开衩设计

looks.tips: 一字肩拉长颈部线条，浅粉色衬橄榄皮；直筒牛仔半裙修饰胯部不紧绷；搭配3cm中跟米色凉鞋。

looks.title: V领收腰连衣裙 + 短款开衫

top.desc: 雾霾蓝V领收腰连衣裙，A字微摆不蓬松，七分袖遮手臂

bottom.desc: 米白色短款针织开衫，长度到腰线以上，强调高腰比例

looks.tips: V领显脸小、延伸颈部；收腰突出细腰优势；短开衫提高腰线，158cm也能穿出好比例！

items: 👡 米白色方头中跟凉鞋（跟高4cm）- 百搭色，粗跟好走不累
👠 裸粉色尖头中跟单鞋（跟高4.5cm）- 延伸脚背显腿长
🥿 编织坡跟凉拖（跟高3.5cm）- 休闲精致有呼吸感
shoes.tip: 小个子选鞋：尖头>圆头；裸色>深色；露脚背>全包裹；粗跟3-5cm最舒适
